$comment: HZ-133. Input/expected pairs for the persona bindings, asserted by BOTH server/test/domain-personas-cases.test.mjs and farm/tests/test_personas_fixtures.py. The `shared` section is the point of the file: domain/js/personas.js and domain/py/personas.py are two independent hand-written implementations, and without this nothing would prove a validation rule, a membership answer or a derived role filename meant the same thing in both languages. Every case in `shared` runs in both suites, and each suite asserts it executed the exact ids listed in shared.manifest. The `js` and `py` sections cover the exports that exist in only one binding; a coverage guard in each suite asserts SET EQUALITY between that section's keys and the binding's real exports. Every agent and persona id — and every model id — in this file is FABRICATED on purpose (alpha/beta, one/two/three) so the fixture is not a second declaration of the registry.
